name: patchState
description: Merges fields into an object state entry; with optimistic set, the patch is rolled back if a later step of the run fails (ACT-007).

typeParameters.name: T
typeParameters.description: The declared type of the state entry at `path`.

inputs.name: patch
inputs.description: The fields to replace; fields not given keep their values.

inputs.name: optimistic
inputs.description: Roll the patch back when the run fails.
